_where_to_put_this: Copy to ~/.codex/hooks.json after enabling `[features] hooks = true` in ~/.codex/config.toml (templates/codex/config.toml). EXPERIMENTAL: Codex hooks are behind a feature flag and not available on Windows; the command strings below are POSIX shell. The scripts are the ones `cortexmd init -g` drops in ~/.claude/hooks/cortexmd/ — if you do not use Claude Code, copy crates/cli/hooks/*.mjs (or plugin/cortexmd/scripts/hooks/*.mjs) to ~/.codex/hooks/cortexmd/ and adjust the paths. CORTEXMD_AGENT_CLIENT=Codex makes the diary agentName `Codex (<hostname>)` instead of `Claude Code (<hostname>)`. Events not listed here (PreCompact, Read/Grep advisories, HUD line) have no Codex equivalent. Reference: https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks and https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/docs/hooks.md — verify the event names, the shell tool matcher (`Bash`, `shell` on older builds) and `additionalContextLimit` against your installed version. Remove this key if your Codex version rejects unknown top-level keys.
